706635.desc: Inspiring Speech now affects party and raid members within 0 yds who are affected by Inspiration.

706636.name: Little Drummer
706636.desc: Allies within 20 yds of you now gain 20% chance to resist curses.

706806.name: Resolve
706806.desc: Increases the duration of your Raise Shield by 1 sec.

706807.name: Deadly Blow
706807.desc: Your Centurion Strike and Broad Sweep now bleed an additional 15% of the damage dealt over 3 seconds.

707137.name: Resilient
707137.desc: Blocking an attack while Raise Shield is active now increases your maximum health by 308 + 10% Stamina + 11% AP for 15 seconds.

707138.name: Paragon Smash
707138.desc: Blocking an attack grants a stack of Bastion. At 10 stacks, your Tower Formation transforms into Bastion. Tower Formation instantly grants 10 stacks of this effect.

707139.name: Paragon Trigger
707139.desc: Blocking an attack grants a stack of Bastion. At 10 stacks, your Tower Formation transforms into Bastion. Tower Formation instantly grants 10 stacks of this effect.

707140.name: Resilient Constitution
707140.desc: Blocking an attack while Raise Shield is active now increases your maximum health by $[1022+0+1022TA*.1+0*.11} for 15 sec.

707170.name: Turn The Blade
707170.desc: Parry the next attack against you within 3 sec. Successfully parrying an attack in this way will disarm the enemy's melee weapons for 6 sec.

707310.name: Clinch Brawler
707310.desc: Centurion Strike is now guaranteed to critically strike against enemies affected by Net Throw.

707311.name: Colossal Reprise
707311.desc: Bash an enemy with your shield, creating a thunderous echo that deals 264 Physical Damage to your target and up to 8 enemies in a 6 yd frontal cone. Scales with modifiers to Ram. Damage dealt with this ability reduces the cooldown of Broad Sweep by 1 sec.

707372.name: Triumphant
707372.desc: Killing an enemy that yields experience or honor now restores 20 Energy to you. Can only occur once every 5 sec.

707411.name: Battlemaster
707411.desc: Increases your maximum Energy by 50, and increases the critical damage dealt by your Press the Attack and Spear Throw by 30%, and allows them to ignore 30% of the target's armor.

712367.name: Overwhelming Presence
712367.desc: Increases the attack power of all party and raid members 5%. Does not stack with similar effects. In addition, increases your Agility by 10%.

712381.name: Mace Spec
712381.desc: Increases your critical strike chance by 0% and critical strikes now increase your critical damage by 1% for 8 sec, stacking 15 times.

800311.name: Pulverize
800311.desc: Slam an enemy with your shield, dealing 3 Physical damage.

800312.name: Spartan Kick
800312.desc: Kick an enemy, dealing 666 Physical Damage and knocking them back a great distance. Usable while moving.

800313.name: Brace
800313.desc: Fortify your defenses, reducing all damage taken by -50% and gaining immunity to stun effects for 10 seconds.

800314.name: King's Valor DEPRECATED
800314.desc: For 15 sec, your energy regeneration is increased by 40%. Grants Motivation.

800316.name: Reprisal
800316.desc: 2 Charges, 6 sec recharge Counterattack an enemy, dealing 135% Weapon Damage plus 16 and restoring 20 Energy. Only usable after blocking an attack.

800317.name: Tower Formation
800317.desc: Increases your chance to block by 10% and increases the Armor contribution from your shield by 50%, but your damage dealt is reduced by 10%.

800318.name: Bark Orders
800318.desc: Increases the effectiveness of your Ballads by 10% for 15 sec, stacking 3 times.

800321.name: Tunnel Vision
800321.desc: For the next 10 sec, your abilities cost 25% less Energy to use, but will not be able to consume Inspiration for additional effects.

800322.name: Banner Lord
800322.desc: Increases the cost of Banners by 100%, but allows you to have multiple Banners active at once.

800471.name: Crush
800471.desc: Slams a target for 134 Physical Damage, ignoring Armor.

800993.name: Motivation: Knight's Valor
800993.desc: Gain a shield that absorbs up to 675 damage.

801772.name: Ballad of the Dragonslayer
801772.desc: Play the Ballad of the Dragonslayer, instantly dealing 7 Magic damage to all nearby enemies, ignoring resistances, and reducing their attack power by -25 for 10 sec.

801774.name: Hero's March
801774.desc: Beat the drums of war, causing your auto attacks to trigger a Sound of War and increasing your haste by 15% for 20 seconds. In addition, allies within 10 yds of you have a 5% chance to trigger a Sound of War on any damage dealt.

801776.name: Ballad of the Conqueror
801776.desc: Play the Ballad of the Conqueror, instantly dealing 12 Magic damage to an enemy, ignoring resistances.

802187.name: Reaper - Remove Underwalk
802187.desc: You twist the soul of your Shackled Husk, consuming 10% of its Maximum Health to assault an enemy target with a terrible scream, dealing 0 Shadow Damage.

802189.name: Fortified Bulwark
802189.desc: Reduces damage taken by 30% for 15 sec. Forgehammer consumes 4 sec of the duration to incur no cooldown.

802195.name: Shieldforge
802195.desc: You smash the ground, dealing 92 Physical Damage to all enemies within 8 yards.

802197.name: Battle Rush
802197.desc: Charge an enemy, dealing 21.714 Physical damage and stunning them for 1 sec.

802198.name: Shrug It Off
802198.desc: Instantly escape the effects of any root or slow and become immune to movement slowing effects for 3 seconds.

802282.name: Offensive Pose
802282.desc: Increases damage done by 5% and also increases the damage of Arcing Strike by 10%.

802283.name: Bastion
802283.desc: Raise your shield and lead your allies within 12 yds, reducing their damage taken by -40% for 10 seconds.

802284.name: Ram
802284.desc: Ram an enemy with your shield, dealing 9 Physical damage, scaling with your block value, and reduces the target's Armor by 4% for 20 sec, stacking up to 5 times.

802286.name: Centurion Strike
802286.desc: Stab an enemy, dealing 110% Weapon Damage plus an additional effect based on your weapon. Sword: Triggers 3 additional auto attacks. Axe: Guaranteed to critically strike for 25% increased damage. Mace: Ignores -50% of your target's Armor. Polearm: Stabs the target and enemies behind them an additional time.

802288.name: Tendon Slash DEPRECATED
802288.desc: Slash an enemy for 22.2 to 23.2 Physical Damage, and reduce their movement speed by 20% for 8 sec, stacking 1 times. At 1 stacks, the enemy is also rooted for 0.

802290.name: Lord of the Arena
802290.desc: Your Pulverize and Broad Sweep now cost -5 less Energy.

802292.name: Finish Them!
802292.desc: Battlemaster Strike applies a bleed effect causing 213.672 Physical Damage every 1 sec for 6 sec.

802293.name: Defensive Pose
802293.desc: Reduces damage taken by 10% and damage done by 8%. Also causes Arcing Strike to cleave 3 additional enemies.

802297.name: Sword Training
802297.desc: While a sword is equipped, your melee haste is increased by 10%.

802299.name: Polearm Training
802299.desc: Allows you to wield polearms and to wield them with a shield equipped. While a polearm is equipped, your melee abilities have 2 yds increased range.

802300.name: No Escape
802300.desc: Reduces the cooldown of your Battle Rush by -10 sec when used against a rooted enemy.

802304.name: Net Throw
802304.desc: Toss a weighted net at an enemy that roots them for 4 seconds. While active, the target cannot dodge attacks.

802305.name: Duty
802305.desc: Increases your block rating by 15% of your Stamina, and your attack power by 35% of your Agility.

802322.name: Weak Defense
802322.desc: Causes damage dealt by Motivating Strike to apply Tactical Strike, dealing an additional 50% Weapon Damage plus 96 to 98 against this enemy while you are in Offensive Pose.

802634.name: King's Valor
802634.desc: For 0, your Energy regeneration is increased by 1% and critical strikes with Pulverize and Tendon Slash deal an additional 1% of its damage dealt. Grants Motivation.

802803.name: The Best Defense...
802803.desc: While Raise Shield is on cooldown it transforms into Spear Throw.

802870.name: Grand Entrance
802870.desc: Leap into the air, becoming immune to crowd control effects, and then crash back down with incredible speed at your location. Upon landing, deal 400% Weapon Damage to enemies in the impact area, plus an additional 611 + 77.25% AP over 6 seconds, ignoring Armor and knocking them into the air.

803126.name: Wreck Formation
803126.desc: Melee critical strikes now have a 50% chance to reset the cooldown of Hammer of the Law. Casting Standard of Valiance now increases your attack power by 10% for 6 seconds.

803128.name: Heavy Expert
803128.desc: Increase your Armor contribution from mail and plate items by 20%.

803129.name: Heavy Blow
803129.desc: Smash an enemy and enemies behind them in a line, dealing 23 + 45% AP High Threat Physical Damage, scaling with defense rating.

803130.name: Line Formation
803130.desc: Increases your movement speed by 15%, reduces your damage taken by 10%, and reduces the duration of movement impairing effects on you by -25%.

803132.name: Hammer of Kings
803132.desc: Grants Motivation Slam the ground, dealing 76 Physical Damage, scaling with defense rating to nearby enemies and reducing their casting speed by 3% for 15 sec. Deals 0% increased damage to enemies affected by Line Formation.

803417.name: Assault Formation
803417.desc: Increases your critical strike chance by 10%, but increases your damage taken by 10%.

803562.name: Lesser Ballad of the Dragonslayer
803562.desc: Play the Lesser Ballad of the Dragonslayer, instantly dealing 101.4 Magic Damage, ignoring resistances, to enemies within 8 yds.

803571.name: Honorbound
803571.desc: Removes the Energy cost of Shield Challenge.

803691.name: Feats of Excellence
803691.desc: Mark an ally for 10 min, causing them to grant Motivation to nearby allies when they interrupt an enemy. Only 1 ally can be affected by Feats of Glory at a time.

803738.name: Shieldlord’s Strength
803738.desc: You may now use two-handed Maces and can now equip two-handed Maces with a shield. Your Heavy Blow and Hammer of the Law now deal additional damage scaling with your Stamina and your Stamina is increased by 15%.

803830.name: Hold the Line
803830.desc: Command nearby allies to hold the line, making them immune to incapacitate, disorient, knockback, and grip effects for 15 seconds.

803895.name: Guard
803895.desc: Rush towards an ally, intercepting the next melee attack made against them and causing you to critically block the next attack against you. Lasts 5 sec.

803958.name: Inspiration
803958.desc: Increases attack power and spell power by 25, scaling with Spirit for 10 sec. Does not stack with similar effects.

803959.name: Feats of Honor
803959.desc: Increase an ally's Armor by 60 to 71 for 10 min, giving them a chance to grant Motivation to nearby allies when they take damage. Only 1 ally can be affected by Feats of Honor at a time.

803960.name: Feats of Glory
803960.desc: Mark an ally for 10 min, giving them a chance to grant Motivation to nearby allies when they take heal an ally. Only 1 ally can be affected by Feats of Glory at a time.

803963.name: Liberation
803963.desc: Instantly breaks an ally free of any stun, fear, or polymorph effects and grants immunity to such effects for 5 seconds. Dispels 2 harmful magic effects from the ally. Usable while stunned, feared, or polymorphed.

803964.name: Hero's Decree
803964.desc: Marks an ally for 15 sec, causing them to become immune to snares, and granting Inspiration to all nearby party members. While marked, any time the ally is hit by a melee attack, the attacker's melee attack power will be reduced by 0 for 5 sec, scaling with your Spirit. Applies Confidence to the target for 1 min.@ext::ext@

803966.name: Thrill of Battle
803966.desc: Generates 4 Energy every 0.5 sec, and increases movement speed by 60%, and increases the attack power bonus of Song of Battle by 20% for 15 sec. Can only be used in combat.

804383.name: Vanguard's Shield
804383.desc: Blocking an attack or landing an auto attack now grants a stack of Vanguard for 1 minute, stacking 10 times.

804691.name: Cavalry Charge
804691.desc: Increases mounted movement speed of all party and raid members within 40 yds by 50% for 10 sec. Can be used while Mounted. Does not stack with similar effects.

804723.name: Call To Arms
804723.desc: Summon a party or raid member to your location.

804896.name: Combat Poses
804896.desc: Teaches you Offensive Pose and Defensive Pose, two light stances to adjust your combat Focus.

804900.name: Inculcation
804900.desc: Whenever you dodge an attack, the damage of your next Staff Strike is increased by 1%, stacks up to 8 times.

805150.name: Broad Sweep
805150.desc: Swing at up to 8 enemies in front of you, dealing 90% Weapon Damage plus 12 and reduces their attack power by -25 for 10 sec.

805151.name: Motivation: Battlemaster's Might
805151.desc: Emanate an aura for 0 that reduces the resource costs of spells by 12% for party members within 40 yds.

805152.name: Final Verdict Reset Passive
805152.desc: Reduces the cooldown of Grand Entrance by 5 sec and casting it now grants Slayer.

805153.name: Heavy Strikes
805153.desc: Your Auto Attacks deal bonus damage equal to 3% of your Main-hand Weapon Damage every 0 sec between each one.

805155.name: Earthsplitter
805155.desc: Casting Broad Sweep now increases the amount of enemies struck by your next Broad Sweep by 1 and reduces its Energy cost by -10% for 6 seconds, stacking 3 times.

805157.name: One Man Army
805157.desc: Allows Pulverize to strike up to 3 additional enemies.

805384.name: Ground Pound
805384.desc: You smash the ground, dealing 71 to 72 Physical Damage to all enemies within 8 yards.

806077.name: Knighthood
806077.desc: Increases the damage reduction of your Raise Shield by 10%.

806132.name: Ambition
806132.desc: Reduces the cooldown of Ram by 0.001 sec and increases its damage by 20% and critical damage by 1%.

806136.name: Soldier's Decree
806136.desc: Empower an ally for 15 sec, increasing Stamina by 10, maximum health by 100, and Armor by 200, scaling with Spirit, and granting Inspiration to all nearby party members. Applies Confidence to the target for 1 min.@ext::ext@

806137.name: Confidence
806137.desc: Damage taken reduced by 2%. Cannot benefit from Decree spells.

806138.name: Spellcaster's Decree
806138.desc: Empowers an ally for 15 sec, increasing their spell haste by 10% and reducing the cost of their spells and abilities by 10% and granting Inspiration to all nearby allies. Applies Confidence to the target for 1 min.

806139.name: Emperor's Decree
806139.desc: Empowers an ally for 15 sec, reducing all damage they take by 35% and increasing all healing they take by 30%. Grants Motivation to all nearby allies. Applies Confidence to the target for 1 min.

807117.name: Wind Wall
807117.desc: Deflect all spell and ability projectiles.

807251.name: Summoning Fatigue
807251.desc: You cannot be summoned again by Call to Arms, Windride, or Drag Through Hell.

850009.name: Piercing Blow
850009.desc: Strike an enemy with great force, destroying any damage absorption or damage immunity effects. For the next 15 sec, melee attacks against the enemy have 1% increased critical strike chance.

887006.name: CoA Aura - Guardian Class
887006.desc: Tuning aura for Guardian Class. Modifies damage dealt, damage taken, and healing done.

887040.name: CoA Aura - Guardian - Vanguard
887040.desc: Tuning aura for Guardian - Vanguard. Modifies damage dealt, damage taken, and healing done.

887041.name: CoA Aura - Guardian - Inspiration
887041.desc: Tuning aura for Guardian - Inspiration. Modifies damage dealt, damage taken, and healing done.

887042.name: CoA Aura - Guardian - Gladiator
887042.desc: Tuning aura for Guardian - Gladiator. Modifies damage dealt, damage taken, and healing done.

8022921.name: Finish Them
8022921.desc: Grants Arcing Strike an 18% chance to cause an Injury to the target, slowing their movement speed by 0% for 5 sec. Using Tendon Slash against enemies with an Injury consumes the effect to deal 0% increased damage.
